items.title: Coherence of a pushforward tested on the integral subschemes through the associated points
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives a criterion for the coherence of a pushforward from an open subscheme in terms of the integral subschemes through the associated points (author lemma at source lines 1642-1654, label lemma-check-finiteness-pushforward-on-associated-points). The proof (source lines 1656-1721) localizes to an affine base, uses finiteness of the set of associated points to argue by induction on its size, splits off one associated point and applies the induction hypothesis to the resulting kernel (proof lines 1663-1710), and then uses assumption (1) exactly at the step where the pushforward of the structure sheaf of the integral subscheme must be coherent; the converse direction is an injectivity argument (proof lines 1715-1721). The induction with the local exact sequences is the content. H2.
